title: OneRail uses Nvidia AI for real-time last-mile delivery optimisation
summary: OneRail launched OmniSTAR, an AI-powered delivery platform using Nvidia technology that helps retailers, wholesalers, and distributors optimize last-mile delivery by automatically evaluating and selecting the most cost-effective delivery option among owned fleets, couriers, parcel carriers, and other modes while meeting service level requirements.
problem_solved: Solves the last-mile delivery optimization challenge by automatically selecting the lowest-cost delivery method that meets required service levels for each individual order.
why_valuable: It enables retailers and distributors to reduce logistics costs while maintaining delivery service quality through intelligent, real-time decision-making for each shipment.
